topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I got the call just as the rain started to pick up. Her voice, like the drizzle, a whisper against the glass. She said it was the tree, the one from her childhood, gone. I nodded, even though she couldn’t see it, running a hand over the damp brim of my hat. Trees, they’re like old friends, you know? Don’t say a word, but they remember everything. I told her I’d see what I could find out. The rain got harder, and I lit a cigarette, thinking about the roots that once held the earth, now just an empty patch of dirt. People come and go, but a tree, it sticks around. Until it doesn't.
